relationships.subject: PB Atoh1-derived glutamatergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: This second, Atoh1-derived macropopulation includes many Foxp2-expressing neurons

relationships.subject: caudal KF GABAergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Foxp2 also identifies a subset of Lmx1b-expressing neurons in the Kölliker-Fuse nucleus (KF) and a population of GABAergic neurons ventrolateral to the PB

relationships.subject: PB Lmx1b glutamatergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: All Lmx1b‐labeled neurons in the PB and KF expressed L10GFP in glutamatergic Cre‐reporter mice

relationships.subject: supratrigeminal Phox2b glutamatergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Phox2b-expressing glutamatergic neurons (some coexpressing Lmx1b) occupy the KF, supratrigeminal nucleus, and reticular formation

key_findings: The parabrachial nucleus comprises two mutually exclusive, developmentally distinct glutamatergic macropopulations: Lmx1b-expressing neurons and Atoh1-derived neurons (many Foxp2+).
This transcription-factor ontology predicts PB outputs: Lmx1b neurons project to the amygdala/BNST, Atoh1-derived neurons to hypothalamus, and Phox2b/Lmx1b neurons to hindbrain.
